definitions.explanation: Keeping indoor humidity at a comfortable level, either passively through absorbent materials or actively with equipment. Common in descriptions of building materials and air conditioners.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{調湿|ちょうしつ}⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: This material has a strong humidity-regulating effect.

examples.japanese: ⟦{炭|すみ}→炭：13375_sumi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{調湿|ちょうしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Charcoal is used for moisture control.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{湿気|しっけ}→湿気：03177_shikke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吸|す}って→吸う：04394_suu⟧⟦{室内|しつない}→室内：03061_shitsunai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{調湿|ちょうしつ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: This wall absorbs moisture and regulates the humidity of the room.

notes:
Refers to keeping humidity at a comfortable level, either passively through materials or actively with equipment. Most often used attributively of building materials and appliances.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {調湿|ちょうしつ}⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧: humidity-regulating function
- {調湿|ちょうしつ}⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧: moisture-regulating effect
- {調湿|ちょうしつ}⟦{材|ざい}→〜材：28347_zai⟧: humidity-control material

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{除湿|じょしつ}→除湿：09623_joshitsu⟧: dehumidification — removing moisture only
- ⟦{加湿|かしつ}→加湿：29748_kashitsu⟧: humidification — adding moisture only
